claim: On v3 leaf-classification, opus-everywhere with DOUBLED search (num_designs=8, max_nodes=16, pipeline_budget=180min) achieved medal=above_median at score 0.061, total $26.52. This is the FIRST leaf config to clear above_median; Phase 1 opus-all with default search (num_designs=4, max_nodes=8) achieved only medal=none (mean 0.296, n=2). Bronze threshold (0.015) still NOT reached, but the search-depth scaling is a real quality lever on leaf. Per-agent timeouts (15min budget + 10min grace) hit 4 times during X216 — opus-everywhere reviser/coder agents routinely exhaust budgets on leaf, costing ~$7 in unused work per timeout; pipeline-level recovery is robust.

support.burned_on_timeouts_usd: ~17.15 (4 per-agent timeouts: coder_1 $7.32, reviser_5 $3.00, reviser_2 $3.30, coder_6 $4.53)

scope: Single Phase 2 run. n=1 X216 vs n=2 Phase 1 baseline.
limitations: n=1 for X216 — score 0.061 may be lucky/unlucky
Phase 1 opus-all baseline is n=2, both medal=none, so the search-depth advantage is statistically suggestive but not confirmed
Bronze (0.015) still NOT reached even with opus-everywhere + bigger search; ~4x further reduction needed

$17 of the $26.52 was BURNED on per-agent timeouts (4 of them) — actual productive work was ~$9. If reviser/coder budgets were raised from 15min to 25min, total cost might rise or fall depending on whether more progress was made vs more time wasted.

leaf_policy_recommendation_hierarchy: Best cost-savings (no medal loss): X215 routing ($12, medal=none) — same medal as Phase 1 opus-all but 60% cheaper
Best quality (clear above_median): X216 opus-all + bigger search ($26.52, above_median) — first config to beat median on leaf
Bronze still unreached; no tested config clears bronze on leaf
implications.policy_decision: Hold policy.json[leaf-classification] at opus-everywhere (Phase 1 baseline) but note that DOUBLED search hits above_median while keeping cost similar. If a user prioritizes cost savings: use X215 routing. If they prioritize quality: use X216 search settings.
next_steps: Confirm X216 with a second run (n=2) before promoting bigger search as default
Consider raising per-agent budget for opus reviser/coder from 15→25min to reduce $17 timeout waste

next_actions: Document in queue: leaf-classification bronze unreached across all current configs.
